summary: CR-385 Phase 0 (M0 read-only shell) frontend QA against preprod. Landed on /pms/front-desk-v2, verified all mandatory M0 behaviours end-to-end at 1920x800; sanity-checked 1366x768 (no overflow, no duplicate testids). Test business date: 2026-09-21. Snapshot from network: counts={arrivals_today:0, arrivals_late:10, departures_today:2, in_house:2}; board rooms=5 total (2 occupied, 3 HK, 0 OOO, 0 available). All required data-testids, routes, greetings, tile/chip numbers, group-by-area headers, row-expansion, one-open-at-a-time, Esc close, keyboard nav, global search focus, alert bar + popover, localStorage persistence, and forbidden-wording ('Channel Manager' absent from Front Desk main, no 'BETA' badge in header) all verified.

Code path is unchanged (no route mutation in App.js diff), so functionally it should still render — flagging as retest candidate only.

Detail panel + fd-room-action-clean-<id> button are wired and present; feature can be exercised by a next iteration with a quiet sandbox.

Route-intercepted 500 recovery for room-status-board (fd-rooms-error + fd-rooms-retry-btn) and for local-reservations (fd-page-error + fd-retry-btn). minor.endpoint: unknown (likely /kpis or a non-LR aiosell endpoint) — 2 x 422 during initial front-desk load
minor.issue: Two 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 422' console errors during first fetch on /pms/front-desk-v2. Neither impacts the LR snapshot render (LR call is 200 and counts render correctly). getSnapshot uses Promise.allSettled so board+kpi failures degrade gracefully; the 422s do not surface as a visible fd-page-error. Backend team may want to confirm which endpoint 422s and whether the payload is malformed for this vendor.

action_items: (minor) Investigate the two 422 responses fired during first snapshot load on /pms/front-desk-v2. LR is 200; the 422 is on a non-blocking sibling call (likely aiosell /kpis or /room-status-board with query mismatch). Neither surfaces as an error to the user, but the console errors should ideally be zero per QA brief.
(retest) Rooms write flow (Mark Clean → Request HK → restore) on r4/8525 was intentionally not executed to keep shared sandbox stable; recommend a targeted follow-up smoke.
(retest) Route-intercept 500 tests (RoomsPanel fd-rooms-error + fd-page-error) — needs a Playwright route intercept run in a stable single-owner session.
critical_code_review_comments: frontDeskService.getSnapshot correctly uses Promise.allSettled for LR + board + kpis and only throws when LR (the required source) fails. Board and KPI failures degrade to boardError/kpisError flags — matches M0 spec.
GuestTable expansion is implemented with a single expanded rowId in parent state (FrontDeskWorkstationPage useState), so switching rows guarantees at most one open expansion — verified in run.
PhaseButton correctly disables when onClick is falsy and displays the exact tooltip 'Available in Phase N' — verified for Bill (4), HK (3), Extend (3).

frontDeskTransform.normaliseTitle handles null → 'No section' and title-cases with space compaction — Area grouping headers rendered exactly as expected (First Floor, Ground Floor, 2nd Floor, 3rd Floor, Patal Lok).
WorkstationHeader partOfDay + agoLabel are pure and driven by meta.server_time / loadedAt with a 30s tick — no browser-clock leak into business date rendering (X-06 compliance).
No occurrences of 'Channel Manager' in the Front Desk main area were rendered (the sidebar label 'Channel Manager' is a global nav item, unaffected).
New /pms/front-desk-v2 route in App.js line 272 is wrapped in ProtectedRoute — correct.
Duplicate-testid audit passed at both viewports.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — all required M0 shell behaviours verified; 3 items intentionally deferred (Rooms write, 500 intercepts, ArrowKey nav) and 2 minor 422 console errors on non-blocking sibling API calls

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://core-pos-deploy-20.preview.emergentagent.com → live https://preprod.mygenie.online. Login: input[placeholder='Email']/input[placeholder='Password'] + button 'LOG IN'. After LOG IN wait for /dashboard or /pms in URL (up to ~30s). Always wait_for_selector('[data-testid="fd-tab-strip"]', timeout>=45000) after navigation. LR request query params (start_date, end_date, view=all) are all sent — verified. Business date on server is 2026-09-21; sandbox has 10 late arrivals, 2 in-house (r3/r2 — do not touch), 3 HK (r4/8525, r5/8527, r1/8528). Testids that WORK: fd-page, fd-tab-strip, fd-tab-{arrivals|departures|inhouse|rooms}(-count), fd-header-greeting, fd-header-date, fd-sync-pill, fd-refresh-btn, fd-new-booking-btn, fd-chip-arrivals-{late|today|tomorrow|upcoming}, fd-chip-departures-{overdue|today|tomorrow|upcoming}, fd-chip-inhouse-{all|arrived|leaving|stayover}, fd-chip-rooms-{all|available|occupied|booked|hk|ooo|turns}, fd-rooms-groupby-{number|type|area}, fd-rooms-group-title-{first-floor|ground-floor|2nd-floor|3rd-floor|patal-lok}, fd-room-tile-<id>, fd-room-detail-<id>, fd-room-detail-close-<id>, fd-room-action-clean-<id>, fd-room-action-hk-<id>, fd-table-<tab>, fd-row-<id>, fd-row-<id>-expansion, fd-row-<id>-detail, fd-row-<id>-close, fd-row-<id>-{bill|hk|extend}-btn, fd-alert-bar, fd-alert-item-<i>, fd-alert-more, fd-alert-popover, fd-search-input, fd-search-results, fd-search-result-<group>-<i>, fd-search-clear, fd-search-empty. rca of the issue: N/A — M0 read-only shell meets QA brief. Two minor 422 console errors on non-LR sibling API calls should be root-caused (likely a KPI or board query param mismatch on this vendor); however they don't degrade UX because getSnapshot uses Promise.allSettled and only throws on LR failure.
